definitions.explanation: Originally, a samurai without a sword at the waist. Now used literally for being without weapons or figuratively for being unprepared or defenseless.
Figuratively, going into a situation without the tools, knowledge, or preparation needed. Entering a confrontation or negotiation at a disadvantage.

examples.japanese: {丸腰|まるごし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丸腰|まるごし}だった。
⟦{武器|ぶき}→武器：03605_buki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}った→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸腰|まるごし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かった→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧。
examples.english: He stood up to an armed opponent while unarmed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧せず{丸腰|まるごし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I went to the meeting unprepared, without any materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸腰|まるごし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧わけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない。
examples.english: I can't go to the negotiation table empty-handed.

examples.japanese: {丸腰|まるごし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{上手|うま}くいった。
examples.english: I went into the interview unprepared, but it went surprisingly well.

notes:
From ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (bare/completely) + ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧ (waist/hip). In the samurai era, swords were worn at the waist, so {丸腰|まるごし} meant a bare waist — no sword. Used as a no-adjective modifier ({丸腰|まるごし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丸腰|まるごし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧: to take on a challenge unarmed/unprepared
- {丸腰|まるごし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: an unarmed/defenseless state
- {丸腰|まるごし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧: to face something defenseless

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{素手|すで}→素手：13817_sude⟧: bare-handed — emphasizes using only one's hands, without tools or weapons
- ⟦{無防備|むぼうび}→無防備：21148_muboubi⟧: defenseless; unguarded — emphasizes vulnerability and lack of defense
- {手ぶら}: empty-handed — refers to not carrying anything; often used casually for visiting without gifts
